payload.name: FSS-Net skin lesion segmentation
payload.fact: The FSS-Net model achieves IoU/DSC scores of 92.4%/96.0% on ISIC2018, 87.3%/93.2% on HAM10000, and 95.2%/97.5% on PH2 datasets.

provenance.title: SegMan-based dual-prior network with boundary-augmented hybrid attention for robust skin lesion segmentation
provenance.quote_or_locus: Evaluated on three public datasets—ISIC2018, HAM10000, and PH2—the proposed method achieves IoU/DSC scores of 92.4%/96.0%, 87.3%/93.2%, and 95.2%/97.5%, respectively
